response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with extensive full-stack (TypeScript/Node.js) and DLang experience, but the role demands deep, current C++ expertise in industrial automation with secure development (IEC 62443), MQTT/message-broker systems, and industrial protocols. His only professional C++ work was a brief 7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, and he shows no industrial cybersecurity or IoT protocol background, making him a poor match despite his overall seniority.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience across web, embedded, and desktop systems
High-performance systems exposure (low-latency DLang services handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong engineering culture: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal and outdated professional C++ experience (7 months in 2014–2015)
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, or OT protocol (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA) experience
Career trajectory is web/full-stack and AI tooling, diverging from systems-level C++ work

key_factors.factor: Strong general seniority and high-performance systems skills
